title: Cute Tray Decor
text: Cute Tray Decor. Valentine's Day will be here before you know it! This is cute tray decor for Valentine's Day. The variety of pieces is nice. Most of the pieces have the flat, mass produced painted look to them. If you're new to tiered tray decorating, this is a good way to get a bunch of pieces for your tray. Then you can add to it as you find nicer quality pieces.

product_metadata.title: Valentines Day Tiered Tray Decor - 5 Pcs Valentines Wooden Signs Plush Gnome Bead Garland, Valentines Wooden Decor for Farmhouse Valentines Day Decorations Party Supplies(Tiered Tray Not Included)
features: ❤️SUPER VALUE PACK - This set includes 5 pcs Valentines tiered tray decor(Tiered Tray Not Included): 1 pc Valentine plush gnome, 1 pc white wooden sign, 1 pc red wooden sign, 1 pc love truck sign and 1 pc bead garland.

❤️THEMED DESIGN - This is a set of Valentine themed decorations, bright color and appropriate text, full of festive atmosphere! Celebrate with these cute and beautiful wooden decor for even more joy during holidays.

❤️PREMIUM MATERIAL - This Valentines gnome is made of plush and felt, odorless, handmade. It has a strong base and is not easy to tip over. Table signs are mainly constructed of quality wood, with clear and bright printing, sturdy and serviceable.

❤️PERFECT SIZE - The gnome is 3.5X9 inch, white sign is 2.3X3.9 inch, red sign is 3.5X4.7 inch, love truck is 5.1X3.5 inch, and the length of wooden bead garland is 15.7inch. Perfect for placing them anywhere, such as home table, shelf, showcase, fireplace or tiered tray.

❤️POPULAR HOME DECOR - This set is special design for Valentines day, can also be a great addition to your holiday decor and will last for years. Great as a Valentine's Day gift to your family or friends.
